2.1.0 brings BitChord to Android, and fixes updating and installing on macOS. This release has an Android APK and a macOS build; there is no new Windows or Linux build in it.

## Android (new)
**The app**
- A phone app of its own: bottom navigation (Home, Search, Library, Downloads), a mini player that opens Now Playing, the Back button, the on-screen keyboard, and room left for the status bar and gesture bar.
- Apple Music's look: SF Pro type, Apple's red, a soft cover-coloured backdrop and Apple's tab bar. It is a new theme, "Apple Music (iOS)", and the phone's default.
- Your account's picture and name sit at the top right (Sign in when you're signed out).
- Sign in with Google or Spotify inside the app.
- Smooth scrolling: a shelf turns one page per swipe, a vertical swipe over a shelf scrolls the page, and the page holds still while you swipe a shelf sideways.
- Album and playlist pages stack the cover, title and buttons, smaller, instead of overlapping. Settings rows and messages fit the phone's width.

**Music**
- Music keeps playing with the app away: a media notification (title, artist, artwork, previous / play-pause / next), lock screen controls, headset buttons, and the next song starts on its own.
- Spatial audio for headphones: switch it on in Settings → Playback, or from Now Playing's menu. A wider stage with a little room around it, voices left in the middle. It is a virtual surround for stereo songs, not head-tracked and not Dolby Atmos.

**Downloads**
- Choose where downloads are saved once: the first download asks for the folder, and every download is copied there. Change it any time on the Downloads page.
- A new Downloads page: where songs are saved and how much room they take, then your downloaded songs in one rounded group with Play and Shuffle.
- Music on this phone: add the folders you want (Japanese, English…). Only those are read, so ringtones and system sounds stay out. View it as **Folder** (one long card per folder), **Album** (songs gathered across your folders by album and artist) or **Song** (every song of every folder as one list). Each has its own page, with Play and Shuffle.

## macOS
- The updater now reads this repository's releases and the file names the release builds actually have. A copy installed before 2.1.0 still looks at the old repository, so download this one by hand once; from then on it updates itself.
- A full icon set, and the install steps for macOS 15 (Privacy & Security → Open Anyway) are in the README.
- One Keychain item for your sign-in instead of several, so fewer access prompts. Sign-ins from earlier versions still read.
- yt-dlp finds Homebrew's Node when the app is opened from Finder.
- Spatial audio (Settings → Playback) and the Apple Music (iOS) theme are here too. The Mac keeps its own look by default.

## Known issues
- Android: Better Lyrics isn't available yet; the other lyrics sources work. Opening the app from its icon after its screen was closed from the recent apps list restarts it, which stops the music for a moment.
- Android: the first build is for 64-bit ARM phones (Android 8 or newer), and it doesn't update itself yet: install each new APK over the old one.
- The macOS build is signed ad hoc, not notarized, so macOS asks you to allow it once.
